job_description_one: Ngaqala ukujoyina i-Decidio ukusebenza njengomelekeleli wokusekela kumkhiqizo i-TRUENDO. Ngase nginyuselwa esikhundleni somsunguli, ikakhulukazi ngisebenza ngemuva kanye nokusebenza kanye neminye imisebenzi yangaphambili ngezikhathi ezithile. Kwadingeka ngifunde ubuchwepheshe obusha njengoba ngingena ngokujulile emkhiqizweni.
job_description_two: Ngaqala ukusebenzela ubaba wami masinyane ngemva kwesikole samabanga aphezulu. Umsebenzi wami kwakuwukufunda konke ubaba wami ayekwazi ukuze nginciphise umthwalo kuye. Ngahamba ngemva kokuthola indlela entsha yomsebenzi. Ukucacisa nje, umfowethu wangithatha lapho ngishiya khona.
blog_description: Ukuqonda kanye nezifundo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-web, i-DevOps, kanye nobuchwepheshe besimanje
about_about_description: Sawubona, nginguMarco—ongowaseNingizimu Afrika ohlala eThekwini. Ngiqede isikole samabanga aphakeme futhi ngaqala umsebenzi wami njengombazi. Ngizifundisile, ngase ngishintshela ekuthuthukiseni isoftware. Okwamanje ngisebenzela inkampani iDecido kumkhiqizo weTruendo. Amakhono ami ahlukahlukene asuka ekwakheni amatafula aqinile kuya ekuthuthukiseni amawebhusayithi asebenzayo. Ngithanda ukudala izivivonyo zalabo abasebenzisa ohlelo olumnandi futhi ngixazulule izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi ngezixazululo zekhodi ezihle.
